title: Heliogarden — GPU Field Study
backend: WebGPU preferred; WebGL2 automatic fallback, both tested in isolated Chrome
techniques: Hardware-instanced crystal garden and animated pollen, capped at 17,580 procedural instances
Nested animated gyroscopic reactor and six orbiting light carriers
Clustered dynamic lighting with directional and two moving point-light shadow maps
HDR bloom, ACES tone mapping, SSAO, distance fog and vignette
Fixed native HiDPI by default; opt-in adaptive resolution and explicit manual recovery
limitations: Wall-frame timing, not GPU timestamps; shared GPU and browser scheduling affect FPS
CPU-simulated instance-buffer particles, no compute simulation or hardware ray tracing
Raster shadow maps; no ray-traced reflections
Touch orbit supported; touch pinch zoom is not implemented
Quick tunnel URL is temporary and changes on restart
testSummary: Build passed. Original scene preserved and isolated Chrome verified uncapped native HiDPI: CSS1440×960 at DPR2 yields2880×1920 at default and max complexity, fixed100%, adaptive off. Full exhibition suite also passed with zero browser errors. Prior original controls/complexity/backend tests are retained in evidence/test-results.json; updated native checks and screenshot are in evidence/exhibition/. Test browser closed.

defaultResolution.backingFormula: round(CSS width × devicePixelRatio × scale) × round(CSS height × devicePixelRatio × scale)
